candidates.name: Pheochromocytoma
support_spans: a 10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl (1984)
24-hour urinary normetanephrine: 0.55 μmol/day (normal value <0.28 μmol/day)
Gallium 68-DOTATATE PET scan (2021): Shows a positive 1.7 × 2.1 × 3.8-cm nodule in the left adrenal bed
Tumors positive for GATA3, tyrosine hydroxylase, chromogranin A, and synaptophysin
candidates.why: The patient's history of a mass of the organ of Zukerkandl, elevated urinary normetanephrine, and positive PET scan findings, along with the immunohistochemistry results, support the diagnosis of Pheochromocytoma.

candidates.name: Paraganglioma
support_spans: a 10-cm mass of the organ of Zukerkandl (1984)
SDHB gene variant: c.338G>A (p.C113Y)
S100-positive sustentacular cell network identified
candidates.why: The patient's history of a mass of the organ of Zukerkandl, the presence of an SDHB gene variant, and the identification of an S100-positive sustentacular cell network support the diagnosis of Paraganglioma.

candidates.name: Neuroendocrine tumor

candidates.why: The patient's positive PET scan findings, the presence of neuroendocrine markers, and the growth of the prostatic lesion support the diagnosis of a Neuroendocrine tumor.
